purpose: Choose bootstrap/repair versus post-setup readiness proof from observed installed state without allowing optional Hermes work or a blocked Windows CMD shim to block the core fleet.

steps.name: resolve repository-owned surfaces
steps.rule: The repository root must be observed and contain .git plus these surfaces. Reject stale hard-coded profile paths before Git/setup.

steps.name: observe installed readiness authority
steps.compatibilityCheck: Observe agent-switchboard.cmd separately; its absence or Windows policy denial is not a core-readiness failure when the readiness authority exists.
steps.rule: Do not invoke post-setup readiness before state plus the PowerShell implementation are classified.

steps.name: bootstrap or repair when required
steps.action: Use the core-autoconfig-defer-hermes workflow when Hermes is unavailable, hanging, or not a priority; otherwise use repository-owned full setup. Reuse healthy components and preserve setup-summary.json/setup-transcript.txt.
forbidden: manually copy Start-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 as a substitute for setup
rerun setup solely because the CMD compatibility shim is blocked

steps.name: verify installed surfaces after setup
steps.rule: A partial setup is acceptable when the only deferred dependency is Hermes and the core authority files exist. The CMD shim is observed separately.

steps.name: prove readiness through PowerShell
steps.action: Run the prove-readiness-through-powershell workflow. Invoke installed Start-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 through pwsh for -ListAgents and generate/resolve the startup readiness report. Treat Hermes unavailable as TBD/deferred; do not block other READY adapters.

steps.name: route next action
rules: CMD shim missing/access-denied with healthy PowerShell readiness authority -> cmd-shim-blocked; preserve evidence and continue through PowerShell
Hermes unavailable/skipped/blocked with healthy core -> core-ready-hermes-deferred; record TBD and continue with non-Hermes READY adapters
verification-required -> preserve launch-time provider/model probe requirement
core BLOCKED/not-configured/unknown -> follow recorded setup/readiness guidance; do not launch work

proofCeiling: Proves deterministic state classification, optional-Hermes deferral routing, CMD-shim recovery routing, and the required next workflow. Runtime bootstrap/readiness success requires observed setup/readiness artifacts; provider response remains unproved.
